what: Several vertical columns (models · products) stand small in a single row at the center of the plate (on narrow screens, an elliptical ring), with only one at full strength and the rest faded to .4. On hover, that column darkens in .1s, and on press they fan out into a carousel in .8s quintInOut so that column stands at the center as tall as the plate, with the farther ones getting smaller (down to .2x), fainter and blurrier — the nearer columns settle first. After opening, moving focus with the wheel snaps to the nearest column in .8s quintOut when it stops, pressing the center column again fires fx:open, and clicking empty space or pressing Esc returns to a single row

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Slots to line up (children, two or more) — parts match height to the set height, width by ratio, and size by scale
options.ring: When panel width is narrower than this (and cells outnumber five), an elliptical ring replaces the single row, default 740
options.blur: Blur of the farthest cell (px), default 8
options.fx:open event: After opening, clicking the center cell reports detail.index and detail.item — for moving to the detail page

note: The original is a WebGL video panel (chroma-key shader) — this part moves only the same layout formula to the DOM, so there is no shader texture or jitter. While expanded it intercepts the wheel over the panel, so if the panel covers the whole screen, page scrolling works only via the scrollbar, keys and touch.

from.where: index.html model row stage (original getLineTransform · getCircleTransform · getCarouselTransform · renderAnimation, with the WebGL written separately in the site’s index.js using the same formulas)
